# Historical CI examples do not prove cause

The try-comm-central record for revision 3c74d825d2a0e77f8df0478f7fe787b8eddfb80c lists bounded examples of historical failures. Use the full evidence and compare each current failure before treating a signature as a match. These examples alone establish neither a current pass nor whether a patch caused a failure.

Scope: Try CI assessment.
